name: garantor-contracts
description: Garantor DAO — on-chain escrow, milestone, jetton, and oracle-marketplace smart contracts (Tact / TON)

scripts.build: npx @ton/blueprint build EscrowFactory && npx @ton/blueprint build EscrowMilestoneFactory && npx @ton/blueprint build EscrowVault && npx @ton/blueprint build EscrowVaultMilestone
scripts.build:v2: npx @ton/blueprint build EscrowJettonFactory && npx @ton/blueprint build EscrowJettonMilestoneFactory && npx @ton/blueprint build EscrowJettonVault && npx @ton/blueprint build EscrowJettonVaultMilestone
scripts.build:v3: npx @ton/blueprint build OracleRegistry && npx @ton/blueprint build EscrowOracleVault && npx @ton/blueprint build MarketplaceListing && npx @ton/blueprint build MarketplaceFactory
